messages:
incidentbot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert fired - alert_id=PD-9832 service=metrics-scrape job=exporter-cluster-a alert=ScrapeHeartbeatMissing
incidentbot: details: 3/3 exporters absent heartbeat for 120s, scrape failures started ~4260001000

maria: acked on PD, picking up. Quick check: are we seeing kafka consumer lag too? I saw an OpsDeck spike.

kyle: I'm on network/ingest, looking at kafka consumer groups. consumer-group metrics-consumers shows lag ~11,200 messages for topic=metrics-raw

josh: I can jump in for exporter side. Any recent deploys to monitoring namespace?

maria: no deployments in last 4h per deploybot. Logs show exporter pods OOMKilled? snippet:
```
kubectl -n monitoring get pods -l app=metrics-exporter
metrics-exporter-7f8b9   CrashLoopBackOff   0/3   2026-03-15T12:23:40Z
```

kyle: logs from kafka-consumer:
```
2026-03-15T12:25:10Z WARN fetcher.go:119 read timeout from broker broker-2: dial tcp 10.0.2.7:9092: i/o timeout
2026-03-15T12:26:55Z ERROR commit failed: coordinator unavailable
```

maria: customer impact estimate? ops-dashboard shows 4.7% of active orgs missing recent metrics, ingestion latency up to 9m. Ping ops.

alan: ops-notify: looped in customer-ops. I'll send an update and recommend "metrics-delayed" badge on status page if >5% but currently ~4.7%

ops-bot: @customer-ops notified (channel: #customer-ops) - template sent.

kyle: quick mitigation plan:
- scale up exporter replicas to 3
- restart metrics-ingest-consumers (kafka)
- if lag > 20k reroute raw topic to backup cluster and backfill from S3

josh: I'll scale exporters now:
`kubectl -n monitoring scale deploy metrics-exporter --replicas=3`
maria: started consumer restart:
`kubectl -n ingest rollout restart deploy metrics-consumer`
incidentbot: PD update: alert acknowledged by maria, escalation paused.

kyle: after restarts, exporter pods come up but one still restarts. Need to check OOM pattern — possibly memory spike from scrape backlog. Dump pod logs:
```
OOMKilled: runtime.alloc failing at 384MB
panic: runtime: out of memory
```

maria: temp config change: reduce scrape concurrency to 2 for exporter-cluster-a to lower memory use. Applying per-runbook:
`kubectl -n monitoring patch cm exporter-config --type=json -p='[{"op":"replace","path":"/scrape/concurrency","value":2}]'`

josh: applied patch, reloading config.

kyle: consumer lag dropped to 6,200 after restart, retention is ok. Backfill not needed yet. Monitoring continues.

maria: customer-ops update: small subset affected, non-critical dashboards delayed up to 10m. Incident priority set to P2. Notifying top-10 customers that hit alerts.

alan: ops-bot posted status page draft. link: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/metrics-4260001122

josh: follow-up: added memory limit bump on metrics-exporter to 512Mi -> 1Gi per runbook step. Applying:
`kubectl -n monitoring set resources deploy/metrics-exporter --limits=memory=1Gi`

incidentbot: PD note: incident cleared alert at 4260001800, but keep watch for 1h.

maria: still monitoring. Will close thread after stable 1h window. Thanks all. :thumbsup: 

kyle: leaving handoff to night oncall in 30m, handing off to jess (night-sre). josh pls add brief to incident postmortem doc.

josh: will write postmortem doc in /docs/incidents/metrics-heartbeat-4260001122.md and link here once done.
